title: How Many Square Feet Is 24x24? 576 sq ft Explained
description: A 24x24 area is 576 sq ft, or 64 sq yd and 53.51 m². Here is how the math works and how to use the area for floor coatings, mats and flooring.

sources.title: NIST Guide to the SI, Appendix B.8: Factors for units listed alphabetically

body.text: A 24x24 area is 576 sq ft. Multiply the length, 24 feet, by the width, 24 feet, and you get 576 sq ft. That same space is 64 sq yd or 53.51 m².

To check this with your own measurements, use the [Square Footage Calculator](/square-footage-calculator). Choose Rectangle or square as the shape, enter the length and width in feet, and it returns the area in square feet, square yards and square meters. The 24x24 example is a starting point, so replace it with the size of your own floor.
How the calculation works

items: Measure the length in feet. For a 24x24 space, the length is 24 feet.
Measure the width in feet. Here the width is also 24 feet.
Multiply length by width: 24 feet x 24 feet = 576 sq ft.

body.text: Because both sides are equal, a 24x24 space is a square. The same formula works for any rectangle. Always measure in feet before you multiply. If you measure in inches, convert to feet first, or the result will be far off.

Measure the inside of the room, not the outside of the walls. The floor you are covering is the open area between the walls, minus any space that will never be covered, such as a permanent built-in cabinet base that sits on the floor.
Square yards and square meters
Some products are sold by the square yard, and some European or metric listings use square meters. The same floor can be written three ways. For this 24x24 area:

To convert square feet to square yards, divide by 9, because a square yard is 3 feet by 3 feet, or 9 square feet. To convert square feet to square meters, multiply by 0.0929. For this space, that gives 53.51 m².
Keep the unit that matches the product listing. A coating priced per square yard and a mat rated per square foot need different numbers, even though they describe the same floor.
Using the area for coatings, mats and flooring

Most floor products list coverage in square feet, so the area is the starting point for nearly every floor job. Start with the 576 sq ft figure, then compare it with the coverage on the product label.

For a floor coating kit, divide the total area by the square feet one kit covers at the coat thickness the label describes. Round up to the next whole kit. If you plan to apply two coats, check whether the label coverage already assumes one coat or two.

For floor mats and rubber tiles, you can either divide the total area by the area one mat or tile covers, or count the tiles along the length and width. Counting is useful when the pattern or edge pieces matter.

For flooring such as vinyl plank or laminate, add extra for cuts and waste before you divide by the box coverage. The [Flooring Calculator](/flooring-calculator) applies the waste allowance for the layout you choose and rounds up to whole boxes, so you do not have to do that math by hand.
Always check the coverage printed on the product label, because products differ. A coating or mat rated for one size may not match another brand, and box coverage can vary by product line.
Pitfalls to avoid

items: Mixing units. Square feet and square yards differ by a factor of 9. Make sure the product uses the same unit you measured.
Measuring the outside of the walls instead of the usable floor. Measure the open floor area.
Forgetting waste on flooring. Plank and tile products need extra for cuts, especially around corners and doorways.
Rounding too early. Keep the full area until you have the final coverage math, then round up to whole containers or boxes.

body.text: If your room is not a clean rectangle, split it into simple shapes, find the area of each, and add them together. The [How to Calculate Square Footage of a Room](/blog/how-to-calculate-square-footage-of-a-room) guide walks through that process.
FAQ
Is 24x24 the same as 24 by 24 feet?
Yes, when the measurements are in feet. Confirm the units before you measure, because a plan or listing may use inches. A 24x24 space in feet has an area of 576 sq ft.
How many square yards is 576 square feet?
It is 64 sq yd. Divide the square feet by 9 to convert to square yards.
Can I use the same area for a coating and a flooring product?

You can start with the same 576 sq ft, but each product uses its own coverage and waste allowance. Check the label for the coverage of the exact product you plan to buy, and add extra for flooring cuts.
How do I convert square feet to square meters?
Multiply the square feet by 0.0929. For this 24x24 space, the result is 53.51 m².
